response.justification: Despite extensive experience, the candidate is overqualified and misaligned with the junior/mid-level role; their senior titles, deep expertise in DLang and embedded systems, and lack of PostgreSQL/React/Nest.js specificity raise red flags about fit, team dynamics, and on-site requirement compliance given minimal German proficiency.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript and Node.js
Strong open-source contributions and architectural thinking
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and domains
concerns: Overqualified for junior/mid-level role, risk of attrition or misalignment
No explicit experience with PostgreSQL, React, or Nest.js as required
Basic German language skills conflict with high on-site presence requirement
